title: Prisma & Next.js Integration
description: Use Prisma with PostgreSQL in Next.js Server Actions, Route Handlers, API routes, authentication, and full-stack flows.
longDescription: This module focuses on integrating Prisma with Next.js applications. You will learn how to use Prisma in Server Actions, Route Handlers, and API routes, how to integrate with authentication providers like Clerk and Auth.js, how to handle performance and security, and how to deploy Prisma migrations in CI/CD pipelines.
whatYouLearn: Use Prisma in Next.js App Router and Pages Router
Call Prisma from Server Actions and Route Handlers
